3583187_ea3794f5.text: Hilar mossy cells are the prominent glutamatergic cell type in the dentate hilus of the dentate gyrus (DG)

3583187_93c88e3e.text: The excitatory neuronal types in the DG include the much-studied dentate granule cells in the fascia dentata and the mossy cells in the hilus. Hilar mossy cells are the principal and only glutamatergic neurons in the dentate hilus. They were named after their "mossy" appearance due to their relatively large somata and thick bushy proximal dendrites covered by numerous large and complex spines which are the sites of mossy fiber input synapses (Amaral, 1978).

3583187_544e24d0.text: These cells are the principal and only glutamatergic neurons in the dentate hilus (Sun et al., 2017).
